result.rationale: Ottawa ankle rules negative: able to bear weight for four steps immediately and now, no bony tenderness at malleoli or midfoot, no numbness or wound, mild swelling with soft-tissue tenderness over the anterior talofibular ligament area consistent with a mild sprain. Home care (rest, ice, compression, elevation, OTC analgesics) is appropriate; seek assessment if unable to bear weight, worsening pain/swelling, or numbness develops.
